cases.name: gate: an English spec with a Blocking row in its anchored section prints the row, not the others
cases.cmd: c=$(grep -m1 "^   awk '" {{KIT}}/skills/plan-implementation/SKILL.md | sed 's#; echo .*##; s#<spec>#{{FIX}}/gate/en-blocking.md#g'); bash -c "$c"

cases.name: gate: an English spec with only a Major prints nothing
cases.cmd: c=$(grep -m1 "^   awk '" {{KIT}}/skills/plan-implementation/SKILL.md | sed 's#; echo .*##; s#<spec>#{{FIX}}/gate/en-major.md#g'); bash -c "$c" | wc -c | sed 's/ *\([0-9]*\)/bytes=\1/'

cases.name: gate: a French spec (## 12. Questions ouvertes, Bloquant) prints its Bloquant row
cases.cmd: c=$(grep -m1 "^   awk '" {{KIT}}/skills/plan-implementation/SKILL.md | sed 's#; echo .*##; s#<spec>#{{FIX}}/gate/fr-blocking.md#g'); bash -c "$c"

cases.name: gate: a French spec with only a Majeur prints nothing
cases.cmd: c=$(grep -m1 "^   awk '" {{KIT}}/skills/plan-implementation/SKILL.md | sed 's#; echo .*##; s#<spec>#{{FIX}}/gate/fr-major.md#g'); bash -c "$c" | wc -c | sed 's/ *\([0-9]*\)/bytes=\1/'

cases.name: gate: a Bloquant row of a French spec carrying the anchor is found too
cases.cmd: c=$(grep -m1 "^   awk '" {{KIT}}/skills/plan-implementation/SKILL.md | sed 's#; echo .*##; s#<spec>#{{FIX}}/gate/fr-anchored.md#g'); bash -c "$c"

cases.name: gate: a Blocking or Bloquant row outside section 12 is never read
cases.cmd: c=$(grep -m1 "^   awk '" {{KIT}}/skills/plan-implementation/SKILL.md | sed 's#; echo .*##; s#<spec>#{{FIX}}/gate/en-major.md#g'); bash -c "$c" | grep -c 'hors section'
